reason: The resume-where-I-woke-up thing does hit my 3-4am problem, so I might poke at the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge. But I'm not paying 4,900 won a month when YouTube with a 30-minute timer costs me nothing, and an app that logs how fast I fall asleep every night is a lot of my data going somewhere I can't see.
objection: Where does my sleep data go? It tracks my nights, wants a morning check every day, and talks about watches and armbands. Nothing here says it stays on my phone or isn't sold or used for ads.
would_change_my_mind: A clear promise that all sleep records stay on my phone and never go to a server, plus the 14-day record actually showing I fall back asleep noticeably faster after waking at 3am.
